title: Blucon unknown state
body:
Hay,

my Blucon does connect it also gets bonded when I enable the option: 'Close GATT on BLE disconnect' but it always says: 'Can't use this sensor as it is in an unknown state'. The Link Blucon app does Work. I tried Rebooting the phone several times with deleting the link blucon app and unpairing the blucon as well as resetting it. The log looks like this.

I have the exact same error.

BluCon says on the webpage: "BluCon works with Abbott FreeStyle Libre, Libre 2 and FreeStyle Libre pro sensors."

But if you install their BluConLink app or whatever is called, the app says: **"This Libre Sensor is not supported yet. Will Start support soon."**

So... i guess BluCon is not compatible with Libre2 and that's why xDrip+ doesn't work also.

This is so missleading, their webpage claims it works. What's going on? Any idea?
@felixsanz For me the blucon is working without issues. Just the connection to xDrip+ has problems.
